. mass can also be heard on radio 106.3fm . the popes intentions – october for mental health ministry let us pray that the mental health ministry be established throughout the church, helping to overcome the stigma and discrimination of persons with mental illnesses. ahane church choir recital on thurs, 5th nov 7.30pm the choir will present an evening of song with the themes of remembrance, peace and kindness in st. patrick’s church, ahane. those who have passed away in the ahane area in the last year will be remembered on the night. admission is free with donations gratefully accepted for the church organ restoration fund. all are welcome. a sincere word of thanks to all who contributed towards the october priests’ collection and last sunday’s appeal for the missions. your generosity is greatly appreciated. castleconnell ahane montpelier cancer support group will hold a candlelit vigil mass on saturday, november 7th 6.30 pm in castleconnell church, for all those in our community touched in any way by cancer – those who have survived cancer, are living with it, have lost a loved one and those caring for them. all are welcome to join in the mass. please bring your own battery candle if possible (some available on the night). blessing of graves – november 1st killeenagarriff cemetery - 11.00 am stradbally cemetery - 2.00 pm st. joseph’s cemetery - 2.30 pm lisheen cemetery- 3 00 pm. prayers will continue in stradbally cemetery every sunday of nov at 2 pm. an irish wish god be good to you in all your days, god be kind to you in all your ways. god give strength to you when crosses lean, god send light to you, the clouds between. god give peace to you in times of strife, god bless everything that fills your life. god send joy to you when grief is o’er, god make way for you in heaven’s door.
